limitations: Published notice processing includes decisions not to act, not only removals.
Google Maps content is broader than reviews; EU-focused legal notices differ from Canadian merchant policy reports.
Overall rows overlap their categories; categories overlap their subcategories. Never sum these levels together.
Empty and omitted cells are not zero. Published numeric zeros are preserved.
Receipt shares describe receipts, not the unpublished case mix underlying each median. A dominant receipt category does not identify the cause of an overall median.
Medians cannot reveal the maximum wait, the tail, the mean or a review-removal probability.
Printed whole-hour medians do not identify an unreported rounding rule or prove instantaneous decisions.
Constructed examples are separate teaching models, not 4004 observed Google cases.
